content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD TGT PGT Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 37 vacancies have been announced under Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Teacher Recruitment 2026. The post-wise vacancy details are given below. The notification mentions 9 TGT vacancies and 28 PGT vacancies across different subjects and mediums.

content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD TGT PGT Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: PGT vacancies are available in subjects including English, Hindi, Chemistry, Maths, Biology, Commerce, History, Marathi, Secretarial Practice, Psychology, Political Science, Economics, Physics and others.

content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD TGT PGT Important Dates
Samagra Shiksha DNH DD TGT PGT Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for TGT and PGT posts must fulfil the educational qualification and age criteria mentioned in the recruitment notification. Graduate from a recognized university in the respective subject with at least 50% marks. Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) from an NCTE recognized institution. OR Four-year B.A.Ed./B.Sc.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institution. Medium-specific eligibility conditions apply for relevant subjects. The TGT eligibility criteria require graduation in the relevant subject along with B.Ed. or four-year integrated teaching qualification from an NCTE recognized institution. Post Graduation in the respective subject with at least 50% marks from a recognized university. Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) from an NCTE recognized institution. OR Post Graduate with B.A.Ed./B.Sc.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institution. For PGT posts, candidates must have postgraduate qualification in the relevant subject with the required teaching qualification.

content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD TGT PGT Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is relaxable as per Central Government orders and guidelines issued from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. What is Samagra Shiksha DNH DD TGT PGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a teacher recruitment drive conducted by the Directorate of Education, DNH & DD under Samagra Shiksha for TGT and PGT posts.

faq.answer: A total of 37 vacancies are available, including 9 TGT posts and 28 PGT posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the interview date for Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted on 10 August 2026 at 09:30 AM.

faq.answer: Candidates need graduation in the relevant subject with 50% marks and B.Ed. or equivalent teaching qualification.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years.

faq.answer: TGT candidates will receive ₹27,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Samagra Shiksha PGT posts?
faq.answer: PGT candidates will receive ₹29,000 per month.
